summary: 为高压火电站、核电站及核心变电枢纽定制。自动探测未授权的测绘、侦察飞行活动，防止异物跌落造成关键线路短路损毁。系统配备固定与便携式反制手段，保障能源工业持续稳定运行。
summary_en: Customized for high-voltage thermal power plants, nuclear power plants, and core substation hubs. It automatically detects unauthorized mapping and reconnaissance flights, preventing foreign objects from falling and causing short circuits or damage to critical lines. The system is equipped with both fixed and portable countermeasures to ensure the stable operation of the energy industry.
key_parameter_1: 设施安全预警: 自动探测未授权的测绘、侦察飞行活动，防止关键线路损毁
key_parameter_1_en: Infrastructure Alert: Auto-detection of unauthorized mapping and spying to prevent line damage
key_parameter_2: 持续稳定保障: 融合固定与便携式反制手段，确保能源枢纽全天候平稳运行
key_parameter_2_en: Continuous Safeguard: Integrated fixed and portable countermeasures for stable hub operation

parameters.适用场景: 火电/核电/风电场/变电枢纽
parameters.反制频段: 多波段覆盖（无线电诱骗/压制）
parameters.防护能力: 防坠落破坏与抵近侦查

parameters_en.Protection: Prevents fall damage and close reconnaissance

detail_html:
能源设施安全保障

在低空威胁持续升级的背景下，电网变电站、石油生产等关键基础设施频繁遭受“黑飞”无人机侵扰。通过参数优化避免对关键设施设备产生干扰，实现变电站外围察打一体。高效抵御各类低空非法无人机威胁，切实守护关键设施安全。

  • 全天候精准捕捉无人机轨迹
  • 参数调优，不影响电力设施运行
  • 适配全天候复杂工业场景
detail_html_en:
Energy Facility Safety

With escalating low-altitude threats, grid substations and energy production sites are frequently harassed by 'black-flight' UAVs. Parameters are optimized to avoid interference with critical assets while achieving integrated surveillance and neutralization. Effectively resists various illegal drones to safeguard infrastructure safety.

  • 24/7 precision tracking of UAV trajectories
  • Parameter tuning to ensure non-interference with power assets
  • Adapts to complex all-weather industrial scenarios
